time_skips: by the time the sun set
somewhere between Tuesday and the weekend
in what felt like no time at all
scene_shifts: on the other side of the door
the scene at school was another story
gradual_change: without either of them deciding it
sudden_change: a knock at the door interrupted
then came the sound neither of them wanted to hear
picking_up_a_thread: which was how they ended up
the thing he'd been avoiding all week finally caught up with him
the conversation from earlier hung between them still
neither of them had mentioned it since
pov_and_focus: what he couldn't have known was
from the outside it looked simple
in his head, it went differently
the version he'd tell later left this part out
flashback_and_memory: he was eight years old again
years ago, in this same spot
some part of him was still there
he snapped back to the present
ending_a_scene: neither of them said anything else
the rest could wait until morning
sleep took him before the worry could
the door clicked shut behind him
it wasn't an answer, but it was enough
